title: Adaptive Memory Index Evolution for Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.34977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents continually accumulate experience, yet retaining a memory does not guarantee access when it is needed. Existing systems can adapt both memory content and access; we isolate persistent access updates as a separately controlled adaptation layer. We formulate this target as Memory Index Evolution and instantiate it with Adaptive Memory Index Evolution (AMIE), a lightweight plug-in layer that evolves per-memory access state from deployment retrievals without modifying stored content or retraining the host memory system. AMIE distils a semantic teacher's keep/suppress judgments into a retrieval-conditioned policy and accumulates its selective actions into bounded state that reweights subsequent host retrievals. Surprisingly, even a zero-call policy that simply accumulates retrieval frequency can match or outperform semantic policies in several settings, revealing retrieval traffic itself as a strong signal for access adapt

translated_title: 智能体的自适应记忆索引演化
translated_abstract: 长期运行的智能体会不断积累经验，然而保留记忆并不保证在需要时能够访问到它。现有系统可以同时适应记忆内容和访问方式；我们将持久性访问更新隔离为一个单独控制的适应层。我们将这一目标形式化为记忆索引演化，并通过自适应记忆索引演化（AMIE）来实现它。AMIE是一个轻量级的即插即用层，能够从部署阶段的检索中演化每条记忆的访问状态，而无需修改存储内容或重新训练宿主记忆系统。AMIE将语义教师的保留/抑制判断蒸馏为检索条件策略，并将其选择性动作累积到有界状态中，从而对后续的宿主检索进行重新加权。令人惊讶的是，即使是仅简单累积检索频率的零调用策略，在多种设置中也能匹配甚至超越语义策略，这揭示了检索流量本身就是访问适应的强信号。
tldr: 本文提出AMIE，一个轻量级即插即用层，通过演化记忆的访问状态（而非修改内容或重训系统）来提升智能体长期记忆的检索适应性，并意外发现仅累积检索频率的简单策略即可匹配甚至超越语义策略。
en_tdlr: AMIE is a lightweight plug-in layer that adapts long-term memory access by evolving per-memory access state without modifying content or retraining, and surprisingly, a zero-call policy that merely accumulates retrieval frequency can match or outperform semantic policies.
